preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of meters of sea n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The tide intensity parameter k must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The maximum depth l must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= d_i <= 1000000000 for d_i in d)
preconditions.description: Each depth d_i must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(d_i + p[t % (2 * k)] <= l for t in range(2 * k) for d_i in d)
postconditions.description: Koa can reach the island if there exists a time t such that the depth at any point does not exceed l.
